feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: Machine-learning analysis identifies an ANAPC-related prognostic signature in hepatocellular carcinoma
entry.summary: An analysis of TCGA liver-cancer transcriptomic and clinical data used consensus clustering and LASSO-Cox modeling to derive an ANAPC-related three-gene survival-risk signature: SPP1, CDCA8 and CFHR4. The study initially clustered 371 cases and excluded six without survival information from… (Discovery - The Second Affiliated Hospital, Guangzhou Medical University; Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center; Guangdong Medical University; announced 2026-11-21)

entry.title: Machine learning combines plasma spectroscopy and protein profiles for exploratory endometriosis classification
entry.summary: A single-center study collected plasma from 37 participants with endometriosis and 45 with other benign gynecological disorders. Seventy had paired infrared-spectroscopy and HPLC protein-profile measurements. Feature selection and a shallow neural-network classifier using mid-level data fusion… (Discovery - Manipal Academy of Higher Education; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: Transfer learning grades oral epithelial dysplasia in patient-level held-out histology images
entry.summary: A retrospective study compared learned classifiers for four-grade oral epithelial dysplasia assessment using 3,777 histopathology tissue strips from 94 patients. Images were divided into 15,108 patches after patient-level partitioning. Xception with ReLU achieved reported patch-level test accuracy… (Discovery - Institute of Advanced Study in Science and Technology; Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research; Arya Wellness Centre; North East Cancer Hospital and Research Institute; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: Learned prognostic screening links miR-130b-3p and NR3C2 to a putative kidney-cancer relationship
entry.summary: An integrative analysis of clear-cell renal cell carcinoma used learned prognostic models and co-expression/target-gene intersections to prioritize NR3C2 and examine its relationship with miR-130b-3p. In 786-O cells, inhibiting miR-130b-3p increased NR3C2 mRNA and reduced proliferation, migration… (Discovery - Southern Medical University; Hong Kong Baptist University; General Hospital of Southern Theater Command; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: MicroRNA classifiers show weak separation of sepsis from non-infectious inflammation
entry.summary: In 299 public whole-blood samples, learned classifiers evaluated literature-curated microRNAs for sepsis discrimination. entry.title: Learned screening prioritizes FOS in human renal reperfusion data
entry.summary: Researchers applied LASSO, random forest and support-vector-machine recursive feature elimination to renal transcriptomic data and converged on FOS and FOSB as candidates after kidney reperfusion. Both were elevated across 41 matched pre/post-reperfusion biopsy pairs, and an exploratory two-gene… (Discovery - Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University; Wuhan University; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: Elastic-net analysis finds limited genomic separation of malaria infections in two connected Amazonian communities
entry.summary: An exploratory preprint applied elastic-net logistic regression to existing genomic data from 47 Plasmodium vivax infections detected in two neighboring Peruvian Amazon communities, including 12 people reporting recent local travel. Repeated nested cross-validation yielded an AUC of 0.625 (95%… (Discovery - University of Antwerp; University of Liège; KU Leuven; Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia; Yale University; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: MedNeXt localizes mandibular cancer invasion in a small retrospective CT cohort
entry.summary: A single-center study trained a 3D MedNeXt model within nnU-Net on 30 CT examinations and evaluated it on 20 held-out patients with histopathologically confirmed mandibular invasion by oral squamous cell carcinoma. entry.title: Elastic-net analysis identifies an exploratory seven-protein anti-TNF response signature in Crohn’s disease
entry.summary: Elastic-net logistic models helped derive a seven-protein candidate signature associated with anti-TNF treatment outcomes in a cohort of 80 children and young adults with Crohn’s disease. A separate analysis fitted models to expression of the corresponding genes in 324 PANTS participants… (Discovery - Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center; University of Cincinnati College of Medicine; Connecticut Children’s Medical Center; Nationwide Children’s Hospital; Medical College of Wisconsin; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: LASSO identifies a three-gene signature associated with colorectal-cancer prognosis
entry.summary: LASSO selection of dephosphorylation-related candidates from TCGA colorectal-cancer data produced a SNAI1/TCF7L1/TIMP1 survival-risk signature. entry.title: AI reconstructs maxillary denture bases from intraoral scans in a clinical feasibility study
entry.summary: A PointNet++ model learned to reconstruct maxillary denture-base geometry from paired scans of 79 patients’ edentulous maxillae and existing dentures, using 57 training, seven validation and 15 test cases. entry.title: A CT-based deep-learning system stratifies postoperative pancreatic cancer prognosis
entry.summary: A retrospective three-hospital study of 592 surgically treated pancreatic cancer patients evaluated a CT-based Swin Transformer classifier. Its disease-free-survival C-index was 0.807–0.844, versus 0.631–0.656 for clinicopathological predictors; their integrated model reached 0.836–0.871. entry.title: AI-optimized magnetic nanobiocatalyst enables recyclable citrulline production
entry.summary: A neural-network-assisted optimization selected a magnetic-nanoparticle formulation of arginine deiminase for citrulline production. The prepared catalyst achieved 70.0% activity recovery, near the predicted 71.18%, and 81.4% immobilization efficiency. entry.title: Machine learning predicts early diabetic kidney disease in a retrospective hospital cohort
entry.summary: Researchers evaluated six survival models in 1,006 patients with type 2 diabetes from one hospital. XGBoost using nine predictors, including the atherogenic index of plasma, achieved one-, three- and five-year AUCs of 0.784, 0.761 and 0.752 in 302 randomly held-out patients. entry.summary: VIPcell combined learned partial-least-squares models and causal-graph inference with single-nucleus data to prioritize immune regulators associated with response to neonatal stromal cells or their secretome in mouse heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. entry.title: Learned five-gene panel discriminates Alzheimer’s tissue samples in retrospective datasets
entry.summary: LASSO, support-vector recursive feature elimination and random forests selected five Alzheimer’s-associated genes after expression, co-expression and disease-pathway screening. entry.title: Learned MRI brain-age gap associates with cognition and disability in geriatric depression
entry.summary: A pretrained convolutional brain-age estimator was applied without retuning to midlife and older-adult cohorts totaling 170 and 154 participants, respectively. Older depressed adults had a higher estimated-minus-chronological age gap than older controls, with associations to poorer episodic memory… (Discovery - Vanderbilt University Medical Center; Vanderbilt University; Veterans Affairs Tennessee Valley Health System; announced 2020-09-18)

entry.title: Temporal neural networks predict three acute critical illnesses in retrospective Danish hospital records
entry.summary: An explainable early-warning system combined a temporal convolutional network with deep Taylor decomposition to predict sepsis, acute kidney injury and acute lung injury from routine hospital records. Evaluation included 163,050 admissions from 66,288 adults in the Danish CROSS-TRACKS cohort.… (Discovery - Enversion A/S; Aarhus University; Aalborg University; Aarhus University Hospital; Horsens Regional Hospital; announced 2020-07-31)

entry.title: Neural MRI models classify liver tumors in a retrospective temporal validation cohort
entry.summary: Inception-ResNet V2 networks were trained on MRI images from 1,210 patients to classify liver lesions, with evaluation in 201 later patients from the same hospital. Unenhanced MRI distinguished malignant from benign lesions with reported AUC 0.946; adding clinical data supported classification… (Discovery - Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, Zhejiang University; Zhejiang University; Hwa Mei Hospital, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; announced 2020-05-28)

entry.title: Deep learning stratifies postoperative cholangiocarcinoma recurrence risk in a multicenter cohort
entry.summary: A neural classifier used 12 clinical factors to stratify postoperative intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma into higher- and lower-recurrence-risk groups. Development pooled 1,421 patients from three centers, with evaluation in 234 patients from another center; the source reports AUC 0.78 for the… (Discovery - Renji Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Second Military Medical University; Fudan University; Fujian Medical University; announced 2020-02-19)

entry.title: Learned ASD subgroups show exploratory associations with disrupted biological processes
entry.summary: Clustering of clinical measures from 2,446 Autism Genome Project cases identified two ASD subgroups differing in severity, adaptive behavior, intellectual ability and verbal status. Analysis of copy-number variants and brain-gene functions linked the groups to disrupted biological processes.… (Discovery - Instituto Nacional de Saúde Doutor Ricardo Jorge; University of Lisbon; University of Coimbra; announced 2020-01-28)

entry.title: Learned selection yields a five-gene panel associated with early endometrial-cancer nodal status
entry.summary: A study of early endometrial endometrioid carcinoma used random forests, sequential minimal optimization, J48 and Naive Bayes to develop a nodal-status panel from tumor sequencing and clinical data. entry.summary: Transfer entropy screened climate variables and lags, and regressors predicted maize and soybean yields from 40 years of USDA-NASS data for 88 Ohio counties. entry.title: Construction and Validation of a Machine Learning-Based Risk Prediction Model for Recurrent Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding in Patients with Liver Cirrhosis: A Prospective Study
entry.summary: A machine-learning risk model for recurrent upper-GI bleeding in cirrhosis was assessed in a prospective development cohort and an independent external cohort. The selected logistic model achieved external AUC 0.827 (95% CI 0.747–0.907). The reported log Bayes factors span approximately -3.4 to -0.8 for the stated priors and dataset. entry.summary: At CERN’s Super Proton Synchrotron, resonant excitation reshaped the vertical proton-beam distribution before extraction; the paper reports measured loss reductions up to 23.5%. entry.title: How far can routine process records predict final turbidity in industrial beer crossflow filtration? A capability-boundary study on 5000 production batches
entry.summary: Across 5,000 brewery batches, models using routine process records explained at most about 8% of held-out turbidity variance; no nonlinear model beat linear baselines and a learning curve plateaued near R²=.10. This is a specific industrial observability/capability result, bounded to the recorded… (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Comparative Supervised Machine Learning for Predicting Cardiovascular Disease among Indian Adults 45 Years or Older: Evidence from the LASI Wave 1
entry.summary: In LASI Wave 1, a held-out sample of 19,335 adults supported retrospective discrimination of current, survey-defined CVD status (Random Forest AUC 0.728, Brier 0.177). This is a cohort-specific retrospective clinical classification result; it does not establish incident-risk prediction, causation… (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Machine learning identifies candidate sepsis molecular subtypes and associated markers
entry.summary: Transcriptomic clustering and machine-learning feature selection identified three candidate sepsis groups with differing observed 28-day outcomes and a four-gene classifier. A separate dataset and cell experiments provide exploratory checks. The authors caution that these groups are not… (Discovery - Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; Hospital of Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Chengdu, China; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Deep learning predicts mortality in a multicenter severe COVID-19 ICU cohort
entry.summary: A deep learning model was assessed in registry data for 900 patients treated in intensive care at 22 Korean centers during 2020–2021. A reduced seven-variable model had an AUC of 0.8247, compared with 0.8500 for the 66-variable model. This is a retrospective prediction result; the study does not… (Discovery - Chonnam National University Hospital, Gwangju, Korea; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
entry.summary: In two controlled antibody lead-optimization campaigns, Claude and researchers identified misleading thermal assay proxies, revised measurements and experimentally improved anti-albumin VHH and anti-mesothelin scFv leads. Small final-lead replicate counts; no mammalian expression, stress testing… (Discovery - Anthropic; BigHat Biosciences; announced 2026-11-15)

entry.title: Machine-learning-assisted prediction and optimization of tensile strength in particulate-filled polymer composites
entry.summary: LASSO, K-nearest neighbors, support-vector regression and genetic-algorithm-optimized SVR were compared for tensile-strength prediction in metal-powder/resin composites. Evaluation used nested five-fold cross-validation on 45 experimental conditions, so performance is bounded to this dataset. (Discovery - Not stated in the abstract reviewed; announced 2026-11-15)

entry.title: FADS1 serves as a candidate shared biomarker for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis related early-onset colorectal cancer identified via machine learning and in vitro validation
entry.summary: ML nominates FADS1 as a candidate shared biomarker in MASH-associated early-onset colorectal cancer, with public-cohort analyses and limited laboratory assays. Authors describe associations and acknowledge no direct genetic perturbation; the result is exploratory. (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-15)

entry.title: Unsupervised machine learning identifies early stage breast cancer subclasses from aberrant glycogene expression and informs personalised drug treatment.
entry.summary: GHSORM clustering of glycogene expression in 785 early-stage breast-cancer samples identified seven expression subclasses, and RFES selected 60 genes that classified the clusters with 90.48% accuracy on a held-out set. entry.summary: Two introductory mathematics courses were studied using Gemini 2.5 Pro to draft scores/feedback from submissions and course references. entry.summary: Machine learning on 11,520 experimentally fabricated radiative-cooling coatings showed power-law decreases in prediction error as training data increased.
